Enable language detection and inspect the ISO 639-3 code returned with the document.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language_detection\":{\"detect_multiple\":false,\"enabled\":true,\"min_confidence\":0.5}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().detectedLanguages)
}
```
